legend.0: Informational: Standard expected activity or benign baseline event.
legend.1: Low: Minor anomaly or unusual action with high likelihood of benign intent.
legend.2: Medium: Suspicious policy violation or unexpected process requiring human investigation.
legend.3: High: Clear indicator of compromise, sensitive host exposure, or unauthorized credential access.
legend.4: Critical: Active confirmed container breakout, cluster-wide compromise, or severe denial of service.
